summary: ClearSign Technologies Corp filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) to register a follow-on offering of common stock. The filing discloses a public offering price to be determined, with an underwriter option for additional shares. The offer is a routine shelf takedown under Form S-3, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other event-driven corporate action. The funds raised will be general corporate purposes. The filing is standard capital markets activity.
